stem: Propene, $\text{C}_3\text{H}_6$, reacts with $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ in the presence of an acid catalyst to form an alcohol with molecular formula $\text{C}_3\text{H}_8\text{O}$.

parts.label: (b)
